title: Style guide
intro: The platform's components, actually rendered, with all their states and on real COP31 data.
authority: This page is authoritative: it serves as the reference throughout development and as a visual regression test. A component that is not here does not exist yet; a component whose rendering changes here has changed everywhere.

themeHint.title: Switch theme while reading
themeHint.body: The toggle in the header changes the theme of this page as it does the whole platform. The contrast ratios below are recomputed on every switch, from the values actually applied: that is where you see whether a shade drops below the threshold in dark mode.
